purpose: Isolated text-evidence experiment for condition/consequence fragmentation. No user photos, no image matching or interestingness claim, no deployment.
baseline: Historical frozen production-v19 run from 2026-09-14. This is not a concurrent randomized A/B trial. Reuse exactly the same candidate text, source snapshots, fixed model and generation parameters, but preserve comma-linked relations and allow multiple actual source quotations per complete statement.
hypothesis: Keeping a condition and its result in one required judgment can reduce accepting individually supported fragments with an unsupported causal link. Multi-source evidence must remain possible for correct compound statements.
adoptionGate: All 12 original labels must match with valid complete quotations. Invalid output is not a successful rejection. Even a passing pilot requires fresh held-out controls and repeated complete evaluations before production adoption. Preserve every failure and never relabel fixtures after model output.
